comparison.objective: Hand-guide a Franka arm to a service pose while correctly holding its enabling controls, then teach the pose.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a narrow three-position enable input while physically guiding a multi-joint arm and pressing Teach.
comparison.success_condition: Arm reaches the specified pose, enabling controls are released, Teach is pressed, and both YAMs clear the arm without collision or limit violations.
comparison.reason: Tests force-guided robot posing under safety-button logic, not mechanical stop adjustment and jam-nut locking.
